en: Come on, give us a dance! What, you won't dance for Team Rocket? Then I'll take that Eevee off your hands instead!
Who asked you? Team Rocket goes where it likes and takes what it wants. Get lost, or get hurt!
Tch! Whatever. Dancing's boring anyway. I'm out of here!
Thank you for saving me. My Eevee and I would have been so frightened without you.
That man won't leave me alone. Please, can't somebody make him go away?
I never miss a performance. My Psyduck enjoys it as much as I do.
Surf lets a Pokémon carry you over the water. With the Fog Badge, you'll be able to use it outside of battle.
That was splendid! You stood up to that ruffian when the rest of us only watched. I'm ashamed of myself.
Please, accept this. It's a technique I treasure, but you'll put it to far better use.
That's Surf. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you over the water once you have Morty's Fog Badge.
